description: Everything Cumulo's Fibre Network Monitor measures for one Celestia validator on the Mocha testnet (mocha-5): whether its Fibre host is registered and ready, where it runs, round trip from each probe region, uptime, how often it signed blobs, whether it keeps the data it signed, certificate identity, flags and, when something is wrong, Cumulo's diagnosis. Look it up by name, operator address (celestiavaloper...) or consensus address (celestiavalcons...). Optionally add live sections from Cumulo: status (ready right now), history (hourly uptime and round trip), blobs (which blobs it signed, did not need to sign, or could not), checks (latest download checks). Not signing a blob is not a failure when the publisher already had 2/3; only "not ready" is. Names, hosts and certificate names are typed by the validators and marked untrusted. Use list_fibre_validators to find validators.

chain.description: Chain id; leave out for the one Cumulo monitors today (mocha-5, the Mocha testnet)

days.description: For include history: how many days of hourly points

include.description: Live extras from Cumulo: status, history, blobs, checks

limit.description: For include blobs: how many blobs

role.description: For include blobs: only blobs where it signed, was not needed, or was not ready

validator.description: Validator name, operator address (celestiavaloper...) or consensus address (celestiavalcons...)

name: get_fibre_validator
